title: Kenworth K200 FUPS Compliant High Tensile custom Built Polished Aluminium Bullbar #1
description: Kenworth K200 high tensile polished aluminium custom built FUPS compliant Bull bar. Custom style main channel with air flow to radiator and heavy duty box uprights with 76mm pipes std. option of 88mm or100 pipe available. Combination LED indicator/daylight running /park lights can be fitted in the outer uprights. Main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in high tensile aluminium backing plate. A lift assist spring is fitted to aid easy access for cab tilt. Driving light mounts to customer requirements.
